# Toonz and Tales

> Original sing-along songs and weekly story-song musicals for toddlers and preschoolers, with animal characters. Free to watch on YouTube. This site has no ads, sign-ups or tracking.

- YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@ToonzAndTales
- Website: https://toonzandtales.github.io/

## Musicals
- Wobble Town Rescue Crew: In every episode the crew helps someone in Wobble Town, and a mystery knot keeps turning up. Who is tying them? Watch in order! A new episode every day at 5 pm Melbourne time, 27 Nov to 6 Dec. Released so far: 0 of 10.
- Coral Cove Crew: A little reef band sings its way through ocean adventures, and someone keeps leaving shiny musical shells. Who is it? Watch in order! Coming soon. Released so far: 0 of 10.
